 In The High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Second Bail Application No.2932 of 2021
Mehtab @ Asif ...... Applicant
 Vs.
State of Uttarakhand ..... Respondent
Mr. Mani Kumar, Advocate for the applicant
Mr. Balvinder Singh, Brief Holder for the State
 Dated: 19.08.2023
Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is the second bail application moved on behalf of the applicant.
First bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 16.05.2023.

2. Applicant Mehtab @ Asif, who is in jail in connection with F.I.R. No.188/2022 under Sections 363, 366 & 376(2) of IPC and Section 5/6 of The Protection of Children from Sexual Office, 2012,
P.S. Transit Camp, District Udham Singh Nagar, has sought his release on bail.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Office, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the instant case; that, it is a case of consensual romantic relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix; that, the applicant is languishing in jail since 02.06.2022; that,
the charge sheet has been filed and there is no chance of tampering with the evidence.

4. Per contra, learned Brief Holder vehemently opposed the bail application and would submit that the prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident; that, during the course of investigation the involvement of the applicant was found in the alleged crime.

Learned Brief Holder would draw attention of the Court towards the statement of the prosecutrix recorded u/s 164 Cr.P.C. wherein she has categorically stated that physical relationships were established between them as a consequence of which she also got pregnant.

He would submit that, in such circumstances, even if it is assumed that physical relations were made between the two with the consent of prosecutrix, it does not lessen the gravity of the offence, as the girl was minor on the relevant date and time and consent of minor is immaterial.
